fold_level_winner_rule.selection_information: pooled true inner out-of-fold metrics only

predeclared_stability_flags.note: These flags are reported as diagnostics. The total-1000 escalation was already triggered by the nominal five-fold result and is not re-decided after observing replicas 0-199.

purpose: Predeclare how each source-bootstrap reoptimization replica is reduced from five nested outer-fold winners per category to replica-level selection-stability diagnostics before any initial-200 production results exist.

replica_level_category_reduction.input: exactly five fold-level structure winners for one replica and one category
replica_level_category_reduction.modal_structure_definition: structure_id with maximum five-fold winner count

replica_thresholds.rule: For the replica-level selected structure, take each continuous-cut coordinate independently and compute the median of the fold-specific development-refit thresholds from only the outer folds whose winner has that selected structure_id.
replica_thresholds.single_supporting_fold_case: the single fold-specific refit threshold is the replica threshold

replica_level_category_reduction.structure_frequency_definition: count each fold-level winner structure_id once; divide by 5 for frequency

tie_resolution.interpretation_of_existing_frozen_rule: This is the operational form of the already-frozen deployment-candidate rule: primary-endpoint ranking evaluated by inner OOF frequency, then lexicographic family ID.
tie_resolution.rule: Restrict to the tied maximum-frequency structure_ids. Their frequency is the frozen inner-OOF-derived primary selection frequency; if still tied, choose the lexicographically smallest structure_id.
tie_resolution.when: two or more structure_ids share the maximum five-fold winner count

replica_level_category_reduction.unique_mode_definition: exactly one structure_id attains the maximum five-fold winner count

required_initial200_outputs.top_two_frequency_gap_definition: difference between the largest and second-largest replica-selected structure frequencies over the analyzed replica block
